jobs.description: At Sandvik Rock Tools in Sandviken, we're exploring how industrial sensor data can provide earlier and more reliable insight into machine conditions. This thesis combines practical measurements on production equipment with signal processing, data analysis, and AI to establish a reusable approach for future condition-monitoring initiatives. Background and purpose Modern production equipment generates many signals, but existing machine data is not always reliable or sampled at the frequency required for condition assessment. Additional sensors may be needed to capture vibration, temperature, acoustic, electrical, pressure, or other process-related phenomena.  The purpose of this thesis is to evaluate suitable sensors and data-collection methods, then analyze data from selected equipment using statistical and AI-based methods. The result should support further development of condition monitoring, diagnostics, and data-driven maintenance at Rock Tools. Work description The thesis is carried out as a structured proof of concept. Together with the company supervisor, you refine the scope, machine case, and success criteria. The work is expected to include:     Review relevant research on industrial condition monitoring, sensor selection, signal processing, and AI methods.     Define machine states, operating conditions, potential failure modes, and evaluation criteria.     Evaluate sensors and data-acquisition solutions based on sampling rate, installation, synchronization, robustness, accessibility and cost.     Plan and perform data collection, documenting sensor placement, machine settings and data quality.     Clean, synchronize and analyze time-series data using suitable time, frequency or time-frequency features.     Develop and compare statistical baselines and AI models for classification or anomaly detection.     Validate performance, including false alarms, missed detections, changing operating conditions, explainability and uncertainty.     Recommend sensors, an architecture aligned with the Sandvik Rock Tools Unified Namespace, a modelling approach and next steps. Expected deliverables are a sensor and data-acquisition concept, a quality-checked dataset, reproducible analysis and model code, a comparison of methods and a roadmap for continued development. The objective is a robust proof of concept and reusable method, not a production-ready predictive-maintenance platform.   Your profile We're looking for one or two analytical and hands-on students with an interest in industrial equipment, measurement technology, and data science. You work systematically, document decisions, and connect model results to physical machine behavior. Your background includes:     Ongoing Master’s studies in automation, mechatronics, mechanical or electrical engineering, engineering physics, computer science, industrial data science or a related field.     Experience with Python and data analysis.      An understanding of, or motivation to learn, time-series analysis, signal processing, machine learning and experimental design.       Good communication skills in English; Swedish is advantageous.  Experience with vibration analysis, industrial sensors, OPC UA, MQTT, PLC/CNC data or condition monitoring is advantageous, as is Knowledge of NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow. Our culture At Sandvik, we work with advanced technology and exciting innovations, but our people are the key to our success. We believe diversity and inclusion create stronger results through mutual support, knowledge sharing and different perspectives. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.  Scope The thesis corresponds to 30 ECTS credits and approximately 20 weeks of full-time work. The start date is agreed with the selected student or students and the university.  The position is based at Rock Tools in Sandviken, Sweden, with access to relevant equipment, data and supervision. Confidentiality, data handling and publication boundaries will be agreed at the start of the project. Contact information For more information, please contact Andreas Nelson, Method Development, at Tools, andreas.nelson@sandvik.comWe’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contacts in that matter. Application Please submit your application by December 13, 2026. Attach your CV, cover letter and transcript of records. Describe your experience with sensor data, signal processing, machine learning or industrial equipment, and what interests you most about the project. Applications by email are not accepted. Job ID: R0099692. Sandvik is a global, high-tech engineering group providing solutions that enhance productivity, profitability and sustainability in the manufacturing, mining and infrastructure industries. Our offering includes equipment, tools, services and digital solutions for machining, mining, rock excavation, crushing and screening.

jobs.description: Volumental is the footwear industry’s leading FitTech™ company, using 3D scanning and machine learning to match people with shoes that truly fit.Our vision is “a world without sizes, where every body fits.” We work with brands such as New Balance, Red Wing, Fleet Feet, and Vivobarefoot across 3,000+ stores in 60 countries, with 60M+ foot scans collected, one of the world’s largest datasets of its kind.Computer vision, machine learning, and AI have always been at the core of our product. Today, we also use AI agents as everyday companions in our work, helping us shorten feedback cycles, deepen our expertise, and explore new areas. We believe the best work comes from people who never stop learning and who care deeply about their craft.Our Products and TeamsWe target businesses and stores selling footwear such as shoes, ski boots and hockey skates, as well as insoles. We develop two related products, each with its own team:    In-store product. We sell a 3D scanner that our business customers put in their physical retail stores and use to scan shoppers' feet. The scanner is controlled by a tablet, which shows the 3D scans and recommends footwear from the store's range.    Online product. We sell 3D scanning and recommendation web components that our business customers integrate into their online store. It allows online shoppers to scan their own feet using their own phone and get size recommendations for the footwear in that online store.We are also exploring new product opportunities, such as 3D scanning beyond feet and footwear. You will start in our Online product team, with the chance to move into other teams over time. Whichever team you are in, you will be part of shaping our current and future products. Algorithm Development at VolumentalBoth of our products are built on top of two core algorithmic systems:    3D foot scanning system. It takes images of a person's feet and reconstructs a 3D model. This involves areas such as camera calibration, image processing, image classification, image segmentation, object detection, parametric 3D models, numerical optimization and machine learning.    Footwear recommendation system. This is based on machine learning and our ever-growing dataset of more than 30 million samples of 3D scans matched with footwear purchases. Given a shopper's unique pair of feet, we predict and recommend what footwear will fit them. This involves areas such as machine learning, probabilistic methods, model fitting, numerical optimization, training, inference, ranking, statistics, data visualization, data cleaning and outlier detection.For both systems, we put a strong emphasis on empirical evaluation and optimization, based on data that we continuously gather from our users. We want to measure what works and what does not (yet) work in practice, and find ways to improve it.You will have the chance to work on either of these systems, depending partly on your previous experience and interests and partly on the current needs of our products and users.Our algorithmic tech stack includes technologies like: Python, C++, Go, SQL, NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, Polars, TensorFlow, Keras, JAX, Eigen, Ceres, OpenCV, Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Devin AI, Greptile, Claude… You will influence which tools we use, and if you find something better, we want to hear about it. We offer premium AI agent subscriptions and encourage everyone to explore, test, and share useful ways of working with AI. We are excited about you because you:    Have experience in both mathematical modeling and programming.    Are a collaborative and kind team member.    Can solve difficult problems in practice.    Have experience working with datasets and evaluating different methods.    Have a master's degree in computer science, engineering physics, electrical engineering, or similar.It is a plus if you:    Have professional experience of software engineering.    Have professional experience working with algorithms in areas like:    Machine learning    Computer vision    Computer graphics    Image processing    Robotics    Numerical optimization What we can offer you:    Personal learning budget and access to coaching    Opportunity to work with a great team of 15+ nationalities in our English-speaking office    Occupational pension at ITP1 level    Flexible Public Holidays Policy    Options Program    Parental pay top-up    Wellness allowance    Flexible work policy (at least 3 days a week from our Stockholm office) The monthly compensation range for this role in Stockholm is 50,000-77,000 SEK. Actual compensation will depend on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process.We are hiring for multiple positions and welcome both junior and senior engineers from all backgrounds. We’d love to hear from you!

jobs.description: Job ID: 7501(Senior) Quantitative Analyst, Model Monitoring and Performance (permanent position)Are you a quantitative analyst with a knack for navigating complex databases and producing clear analysis? Do you have knowledge of credit risk processes and an interest in, or experience with, IRB, IFRS9 or similar models? Then this opportunity may be for you! Quantitative Analyst to join the Model Monitoring and Performance team (MMP) within Risk Models.Nordea are currently developing and implementing a suite of new, state-of-the-art IRB and IFRS9 models. MMP is responsible for ensuring that the new models’ performance is continuously scrutinized, and for identifying any issues arising within them. Further, we are responsible for assessing and overseeing how IRB models are used in credit processes, including whether model use is in line with regulations, internal requirements and the approved purpose of the models.Our key stakeholders are model developers, model users in Business and senior management. About our teamMeet the Model Monitoring and Performance team. Our role is to contribute to assessments of how IRB models are used in credit processes, communicate identified issues and help develop clear internal guidelines for appropriate model use.Our team is an inspiring, competent and creative group of professionals in an international environment. In your daily job, you’ll be applying your quantitative and data analysis skills to produce clear and concise communication about model performance and performance issues to model developers and senior management. You’ll mainly be working with Python, SQL and Snowflake, but SAS and other tools may be used here and there. The role will be located in Helsinki or Stockholm and team colleagues are in Stockholm, Helsinki and Copenhagen.Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. What you’ll be doingMain responsibilities in this role:    Quantitative analysis of model performance for all components of IRB and/or IFRS9 models (PD, LGD, EAD).    Communicating conclusions of your analysis to model developers and senior management – in reports and meetings.    Developing, maintaining and operating the IRB and IFRS9 model performance monitoring frameworks.    Collaborating with a variety of stakeholders including risk management, model development, model validation and model users across the bank.    Assessing how IRB models are used in credit processes, identifying potential gaps against regulatory and internal requirements, and communicating conclusions and follow-up needs.Who you areThis is the right role for you if you:    Are driven by a desire to know more.    Love to make sense of data.    Are self-driven and take ownership.    Find it easy to understand others, and make yourself understood by others.    Love to think in terms of the big picture, but know that the devil is in the details.    Enjoy learning, and are excited about bringing your ideas to the table.    Are honest and reliable, and willing to speak up even when it’s difficult.    Think it is important to get governance right.Your background and skills include:    Master’s in a quantitative field such as mathematics, engineering, econometrics, data science, finance, or similar.    Excellent communication skills (English is the working language).    Sound knowledge of applied mathematical modelling and excellent quantitative skills.    Proficiency in Python and SQL.    Knowledge of credit risk processes and how risk models and parameters are used in credit assessment and decision-making.    Knowledge of or interest in IRB, IFRS9 or similar models – practical experience with model use, monitoring or governance is a definitive plus.What we offerPeople come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. jobs.employer_name: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description: Job DescriptionWHAT YOU’LL DO​As a Sales Advisor at H&M, you’ll play a key role in creating an outstanding customer experience. You’ll welcome customers, guide them through your store, and support them in finding what they need while showcasing our products. Acting in line with our values, you’ll contribute to both your own success and the success of the company.You will:    Share your fashion and product knowledge to help customers make informed choices.    Collaborate with your team to deliver exceptional service at every step of the customer journey.    Ensure the sales floor and back of house are well-stocked, organized, and inviting.    Support with opening and closing of the store.    Represent yourself and the brand positively during all customer interactions.WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH​Our stores are the heart of our company, where customers experience our brand firsthand. As part of the dynamic Store Team, every role—from Sales Advisors, Department Managers, Store Managers and Visual Merchandisers to Assistant Store Managers, Cash Office Responsible, and Delivery Responsible in larger stores—contributes to creating an inspiring and welcoming environment. You’ll also connect with the wider Area Team, collaborating across stores to share insights and drive success together. Alongside your team, you'll play a vital role in helping customers feel confident and express their individuality with the latest trends and timeless styles. By building meaningful connections with customers in our stores, we make fashion accessible and sustainable for all.WHO YOU ARE​We are looking for people with…​    Experience in customer service within fashion, retail, or similar fields.And people who are…​    Passionate about fashion and delivering an exceptional in-store experience while promoting our products and driving sales.    Thriving in collaborative and dynamic environments.    Communicative, creative, curious to work with store technology, with a strong eagerness to learn and develop.    Flexible and action oriented.WHO WE ARE​H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​​We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​     All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online.     In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here. JOIN US​Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​This is a temporary on-demand position with no guaranteed hours. Work will be offered based on business needs with a start in December or by agreement. We are currently looking for people to our store located in Kista Galleria and you should be available to work during store opening hours. Language skills in Swedish or English are required.We have an ongoing selection, so the position may be filled before the application deadline, so send in your application today! The last application date is 25/11.Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​* Store roles assessment: To manage the high volume of applications for the Sales Advisor role, we use an online assessment method for skills-based recruitment within some of our stores. You will need to complete it as part of the application and screening process. Your responses will be scored by an assessment tool that applies predefined criteria set by H&M Group. Please look out for an email in your inbox/junk email from MAKI. After completing the assessment, you’ll have the opportunity to share feedback and ask questions. If you experience any difficulties or prefer an alternative assessment method, please contact recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative will not impact on your application. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice. ** We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

The opportunity Join Hitachi Energy in Västerås and play a key role in shaping the future of power system software. As a Senior R&D Developer, you will contribute to the continued development of the Network Manager platform, transforming complex technical challenges into innovative solutions that support critical energy infrastructure worldwide. Working in a collaborative and highly skilled team, you will develop new features, enhance platform capabilities, and help drive the evolution of a product that enables more reliable, efficient, and sustainable power networks.How you’ll make an impact    Troubleshoot and resolve complex software issues through in-depth source code analysis and debugging.    Design, develop, and enhance core database engine capabilities using C and C++, with C# applied where it adds value.    Analyze and resolve issues within distributed communication frameworks, including IPC and CORBA-based systems.    Investigate and improve system correctness, performance, scalability, and reliability across the platform.    Perform code and design reviews to ensure high-quality, maintainable, and robust software solutions.    Mentor and support junior developers, fostering technical growth and promoting engineering best practices.Your background    Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.    Strong proficiency in C and C++; experience with C# is considered an advantage.    Hands-on experience developing and troubleshooting multithreaded applications on both Linux and Windows platforms.    Proven experience developing database engines, storage systems, or other high-performance systems software.    Solid understanding of redundancy, fault tolerance, and high-availability architectures.    Excellent analytical, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.    Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in Swedish is considered an advantage.More About Us​​We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​    Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​    Group life insurance and additional insurances. ​    Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​    Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​    Health care and wellness allowance ​    Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​    Psychological support program ​    Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​    Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​    Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​​The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations. ​Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application already today. Questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Gustaf Hedström, gustaf.hedstrom@hitachienergy.comUnion representatives – Sveriges Ingenjörer: Jan Skogeby, jan.skogeby@hitachienergy.com; Ledarna: Frank Hollstedt, frank.hollstedt@hitachienergy.com; Unionen: Karin Ulvemark, karin.ulvemark@hitachienergy.com

ROXON specializes in demanding bulk material handling solutions. We design and deliver conveyor systems, modernizations, maintenance services, and spare parts for material handling equipment. Our comprehensive solutions and world-class lifecycle support serve industries including mining, energy, pulp and paper, and process manufacturing. At ROXON, decades of engineering expertise meet innovation. Our success is built on the passion, dedication, and professional excellence of our people. Trust, technical expertise, and the capability to take on even the most challenging projects are the core values that drive our project business.We are now looking for a Field Project Manager to join our team in Malmfälten.As a Field Project Manager, you are responsible for ensuring successful project delivery from planning & designing through completion. Your role includes managing schedules, budgets, customer communication, and on-site activities while ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, and to the highest quality standards.You will lead equipment delivery and modernization projects, coordinate installation work and subcontractors, and act as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the project life cycle. The role requires close cooperation with sales, service, engineering, purchasing, and other internal teams to ensure smooth execution and excellent customer experience. You will support site operations when needed and promote a proactive, customer-focused, and solution-oriented way of working.Based in Gällivare, this position offers a hands-on opportunity to work with industrial and material handling projects in a dynamic mining environment, where strong leadership, practical problem-solving skills, and a "get things done" mindset are highly valued!Qualifications:- Technical understanding of mechanical systems, industrial equipment, conveyor technology, or material handling solutions /equipment- Strong leadership and coordination skills.- Ability to read and understand technical drawings.- Self-driven and capable of working independently while taking ownership of project activities, customer relationships, and business development initiatives.- Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills in both Swedish and English.- Willingness to travel frequently within Sweden; a valid driver's license is required.The ideal candidate is passionate about building long-term customer relationships, developing successful partner networks, and driving product performance and market growth. You thrive in a hands-on environment where you can combine strategic thinking with active customer engagement. The role can be tailored to match your skills, experience, and strengths.What We Offer:- A key role in growing a cutting-edge conveyor products in local markets.- The opportunity to take ownership of projects for a strategically important market area.- An international working environment within a strong global industrial group (NEPEAN).- Support from an experienced organization.Why join us?You'll become part of a growing team where attitude matters as much as experience. We offer training, responsibility, and the opportunity to make a real impact on customer success across Northern Sweden and Norway.Interested?Please submit your application in English by December 7, 2026, [via this link](https://ats.talentadore.com/apply/field-project-manager-sweden/ZlE0qd).Please note that we review applications and interview candidates throughout the application period. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.For further information about the position, please contact our recruitment partner: Liena Silen p. +358 40 482 6770 or liena.silen@eezy.fi and Saara Saalo +358 40 183 6260 or saara.saalo@eezy.fiROXON Sweden ABAt ROXON, we are committed to delivering solutions that are truly optimal for our customers' operations. We believe that honesty and transparency create something far more valuable than a few percentage points: trust.Rather than offering standard, one-size-fits-all solutions, we provide tailored systems built on strong process expertise and a deep understanding of each customer's unique needs. We take the time to understand our customers' challenges and evaluate different solution alternatives together with realistic implementation schedules.We call this approach the Nordic Way. It is built on continuous dialogue, close collaboration, and shared problem-solving with our customers.Phone: +358 40 482 6770 Location: Gällivare

jobs.occupation: Process Excellence Support in Logistics for BSH Northern Europe
jobs.description: BSH Home Appliances is a global leader in the home appliance industry, committed to creating innovative solutions that enhance the quality of life at home. BSH Northern Europe oversees the Nordic countries as well as Latvia, Lithuania, and Estonia. We take pride in offering top-quality brands, including Bosch, Siemens, NEFF, and Gaggenau.If you are passionate about operational efficiency and eager to contribute your expertise in logistics, join us in shaping the future of home appliances at the BSH-operated warehouse in Nykvarn.In your role as Process Excellence Support, you will be responsible for addressing the bugs, gaps and enhancements of logistics systems and processes for BSH Northern Europe. You will play a vital role in ensuring seamless daily operations and fostering continuous improvements.YOUR RESPONSIBILITIESYour success will be defined by:    Driving sustainable system and process solutions that enhance operational efficiency and reduce costs    Timely and successful completion of projects within scope and targetsYou will achieve these by:    Provide first line support for system bugs and process gaps    Analyze data and carry out direct observations to identify root causes and opportunities    Map processes, create flow charts and gap analyses to define improvement scope    Lead and execute "system and process changes", "new implementations", and "optimization initiatives"    Coordinate and communicate with internal and external stakeholders    Identify and initiate AI and automation opportunitiesYOUR PROFILE    Degree in industrial engineering or similar    Foundation knowledge in logistics including warehouse and transport processes    Analytical ability, agile and proactive mindset with excellent problem‑solving skills    SAP-S4 Hana: transport management system - TMS/TM invoicing, last mile control - LMC, warehouse management - WM/EWM, forklift management – ITM, track and trace system – GTT, data tables, interfaces, EDI/API connection, carrier connector    Experience leading continuous improvement projects and applying AI/advanced analytics    Proficient in office suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio, Power BI)    Fluent in English, Nordic language is a plusApplicationFor more information about the role, please feel free to contact Sercan Eminoglu, Head of Process Excellence, mailto:sercan.eminoglu@bshg.com. jobs.occupation: Epidemiologist / Public Health Specialist – Respiratory Viruses (ECDC)
jobs.description: Job descriptionJunior Expert – Respiratory Viruses Surveillance (Consultant Assignment)Location: Stockholm, Sweden (European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control – ECDC)Start Date: Mid-January 2027Duration: Initial 3-month contract (maternity leave cover, with strong potential for extension)Application Deadline: November 25th, 2026Are you passionate about public health, epidemiology, and infectious disease surveillance? Randstad Life Sciences is currently looking for a Junior Expert to join the Respiratory Viruses Section at the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) in Stockholm.This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to European health security and work at the forefront of zoonotic respiratory virus monitoring in an international, scientific environment.About the AssignmentAs a Junior Expert consultant, you will support the Respiratory Viruses Section in monitoring, assessing, and reporting on respiratory pathogens, with a specific focus on zoonotic influenza. The assignment covers a maternity leave starting in mid-January 2027, with an initial 3-month order and an expected extension thereafter.Key Responsibilities:    Support event-based surveillance of respiratory viruses and the ongoing monitoring of zoonotic respiratory viruses.    Assist in updating risk assessments regarding avian influenza for humans within the EU/EEA.    Contribute to the drafting and compilation of avian influenza monitoring reports.    Maintain and update records of zoonotic influenza cases.    Provide input and support to colleagues regarding indicator-based surveillance of respiratory viruses, specifically related to potential zoonotic influenza events and data from individuals exposed to animals with avian or swine influenza.Qualifications and ExperienceTo succeed in this role, you bring a solid scientific foundation combined with strong analytical and communication skills.Required Competences:    Education/Background: A university degree or relevant professional experience in public health, epidemiology, disease surveillance, or respiratory viruses.    Domain Knowledge: Good understanding of epidemiology, communicable disease prevention and control, zoonoses (particularly respiratory viruses), and the One Health approach.    Surveillance & Data: Prior understanding and some hands-on experience with communicable disease surveillance, data collection, and scientific reporting.    Technical Skills: Very good proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).    Language & Communication: Very good command of English, alongside excellent written and spoken communication skills.What We OfferAt Randstad Life Sciences, we specialize in matching scientific talent with leading organizations. As a consultant with us, you will have a dedicated Consultant Manager supporting you throughout your assignment, competitive employment terms, and the chance to gain invaluable experience within an EU agency.How to ApplyIf you are ready to take the next step in your public health career, please submit your application as soon as possible, as selection is ongoing.Important Application Instructions:Our application system only allows you to upload one single file. Therefore, you must merge the following two documents into one combined PDF or Word file before applying:    Your CV in English (preferably using the Europass CV template).    A Motivation Letter in English (maximum 1 page) clearly outlining your job-specific expertise and the personal characteristics you bring to this role.Applications missing either document or not merged into a single file cannot be processed for client submission.We look forward to receiving your application!ResponsibilitiesKey Responsibilities:    Support event-based surveillance of respiratory viruses and the ongoing monitoring of zoonotic respiratory viruses.    Assist in updating risk assessments regarding avian influenza for humans within the EU/EEA.    Contribute to the drafting and compilation of avian influenza monitoring reports.    Maintain and update records of zoonotic influenza cases.    Provide input and support to colleagues regarding indicator-based surveillance of respiratory viruses, specifically related to potential zoonotic influenza events and data from individuals exposed to animals with avian or swine influenza.QualificationsTo succeed in this role, you bring a solid scientific foundation combined with strong analytical and communication skills.Required Competences:    Education/Background: A university degree or relevant professional experience in public health, epidemiology, disease surveillance, or respiratory viruses.    Domain Knowledge: Good understanding of epidemiology, communicable disease prevention and control, zoonoses (particularly respiratory viruses), and the One Health approach.    Surveillance & Data: Prior understanding and some hands-on experience with communicable disease surveillance, data collection, and scientific reporting.    Technical Skills: Very good proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).    Language & Communication: Very good command of English, alongside excellent written and spoken communication skills.About the companyRandstadPå Randstad vet vi att alla människor har en plats på arbetsmarknaden.
